integrity: The stated formulas are established by direct matrix algebra; finite checks test identities but do not prove the parameter-uniform result. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-dimensional SPD identity-system model with a general nonsymmetric linear residual smoother; not derived from a specific additive Schwarz decomposition. Spectral-radius comparison is asymptotic and is not a whole-solver runtime benchmark. Prior equivalent treatments outside inspected sources remain possible.
title: Sharp spectral reversal under orthogonal coarse-space enrichment for a contractive Jordan smoother
